fixed_skip.why: At loop bandwidth 0.01 the phase error of the 16-QAM loop needs about 1000 symbols to settle; until then decisions near a boundary are ambiguous, the rounding of the fixed-point samples flips 37 of them (symbols 270-604, none after) and the two loops follow different paths to the same lock. Compared from symbol 1000.

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Sine table of the NCO and the CORDIC arctangent (16 iterations, residual 3e-5 rad): the derotated samples differ by the table error; a decision may differ only where the quantised sample is within that of a decision boundary.
